_about: Where to get a part for less: Wilmington / Harbor area + near the shop. Business info only, verified 2026-10-13 from each business's own site or its Google Business listing (see source). No partnership, price or stock claim. lat/lng geocoded at build time (OpenStreetMap Nominatim; US Census geocoder where Nominatim had no house number). Types: new = independent discount store, chain = chain store (for comparison), self = used self-serve yard (you pull the part), full = used full-service dismantler (they pull it).
